findings.title: Misleading 'convert' 403 for non-conversion edits
findings.problem: _ensure_personal_setting_owner runs on every PUT and always raises raise_forbidden("convert"), so a non-owner who sends an unchanged project_name is rejected with a message about converting although nothing would be converted.
findings.impact: Only the error text is inaccurate; the rejection itself is correct and intended (non-owners must not modify another user's personal integration). Callers may be confused about why a plain edit is refused.
findings.recommendation: raise_forbidden("convert" if request.project_name != setting.project_name else "update"), or pass the action label into the helper.

fix.change: _ensure_personal_setting_owner raises 'convert' only when project_name changes, otherwise 'update'

deferred.title: DELETE route lacks personal-setting owner check
deferred.problem: delete_project_setting only runs _check_permission on setting.project_name and the budget-hidden guard, so a project admin can delete another user's USER-typed integration. Reachability for personal rows carrying a project_name was not confirmed.
deferred.preexisting: delete_project_setting is untouched by this change; the task scopes the restriction to PUT conversion.
